text: 1.The applicant, who is between18-25 years old, has graduated from high school, has achieved above level 4(including) in HSK can apply for programs taught in Chinese.2.The high school graduate without certificate of HSK can apply for our Try-out Courses after approval by interview, the validity of trial period is one year.3.Programs in English:1) English is the native language/official language; or2) IELTS5.5 or TOEFL 60; or3) Studied courses taught in English in high school or college; or4) English level admitted by ZJUT.
